acceptance_conditions: Every promoted row is a direct official planning.data.gov.uk brownfield-land entity.
End date is blank/current, quality is authoritative, point is present, and minimum/maximum net dwellings are positive.
Every promoted entity passes an individual repository duplicate search.
Fail-closed exclusions remain visible with reason codes and are never promoted.
Website panel exposes every researched row with entity link, capacity, point, gate result and confidence.
No canonical parcel assignment or future-growth score is produced without the missing canonical shard export and geometry intersection.
Status, checkpoint, progress, heartbeat and readback paths agree on wave counts.
